entities.summary: Dinanath Batra, also spelled Dina Nath Batra, was an Indian educationist who was the general secretary of Vidya Bharati, the school network run by the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). He also founded the educational activist organisations Shiksha Bachao Andolan Samiti and Shiksha Sanskriti Utthan Nyas.
